errors.evidence: This is a horizontal bar chart. The category axis (listing Top100, Top200, etc.) is the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.
This is a horizontal bar chart. The value axis (from 0 to 400) is the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.
The legend for the blue bars is labeled '频次' (frequency of occurrence), not '频率' (frequency/rate).
The values for the orange bars are not just between 10-20. They range up to approximately 30 for the 'Top1000' category.

Multiple values for the blue bars are significantly overestimated. For instance, the value for Top200 is approximately 80 (not 90), for Top300 it is approximately 125 (not 140), for Top400 it is approximately 160 (not 180), for Top500 it is approximately 195 (not 220), for Top600 it is approximately 240 (not 260), and for Top700 it is approximately 275 (not 300).
